question: In _________, a Subsidiary Alliance system was imposed on Awadh by the British.
solution:
The correct answer is __1801__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Subsidiary Alliance had been imposed on Awadh in 1801.
 
• By the terms of the Alliance, the **Nawab had to disband its military force and allow the British to position its troops within the kingdom and act in accordance **with the advice of the **British Resident who was now to be attached to the court.**
